system.description:
When targeted by an attack you may roll up to as many Skill Dice as you have banked Luck Points. If any shows a Luck symbol you take no damage from that attack. Lose 1 banked Luck Point per die rolled, whatever the result.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.59
